## 1. BRAND IDENTITY & CORE PHILOSOPHY
- **Name:** qnt. (Pure Syne Bold lowercase with trailing dot)
- **Tagline:** Deterministic Quantitative Wealth Architecture & Sovereign Institutional Operating System.
- **Visual Personality:** High-Contrast Sovereign Swiss Editorial & Liquid Frosted Glassmorphism.
- **Aesthetic Principles:**
  - Zero-Void Layout Density (Every millimeter delivers computational signal).
  - Physical 3D Optical Glass Refraction (MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission: 0.95, IOR: 1.52).
  - Multi-Registry UI Component Integration (21st.dev, Aceternity, Componentry, Toggle Supply, React Bits, Motion Dev).

## 3. LIQUID FROSTED GLASS TOKEN SPECIFICATION

```css
/* True Liquid Frosted Glass Panel Token */
.liquid-glass-panel {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  border-radius: 32px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.liquid-glass-panel:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), inset 0 0 0 1.5px #06B6D4;
  border-color: #06B6D4;
}

/* 3D Glass Stage Container */
.glass-canvas-container {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 100%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  border-radius: 32px;
  cursor: grab;
}
.glass-canvas-container:active {
  cursor: grabbing;
}
```

## 5. THREE.JS 3D LIQUID GLASS SHADER PARAMETERS

```javascript
// Physical Glass Material Token
const liquidGlassMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
  color: 0xFFFFFF,              // Base glass tint
  metalness: 0.05,              // Low metallic
  roughness: 0.02,              // Ultra-smooth mirror polish
  transmission: 0.96,           // Optical light passthrough (96%)
  thickness: 3.2,               // Refraction depth
  ior: 1.52,                    // Standard Crown Glass Refraction Index
  specularIntensity: 1.0,       // High specular sheen
  clearcoat: 1.0,               // Top liquid lacquer layer
  clearcoatRoughness: 0.05,
  transparent: true,
  opacity: 0.95
});
```

## 6. UI/UX COMPONENT SPECIFICATIONS ACROSS 7 REGISTRIES

1. **`21st.dev` Data Tables & Command Palettes:**
   - Multi-tier in-memory asset filters (`all`, `tier1`, `tier2`, `tier3`, `tier4`).
   - In-situ jargon decoders and live regex search box.
2. **`ui.aceternity.com` Animated Bento Grids & Spotlights:**
   - Dynamic cursor-following radial spotlight on card hover.
   - Expandable factor allocation drawers (`+ EXPAND` ➔ `− COLLAPSE`).
3. **`refero.design` SaaS Metrics Docks:**
   - High-contrast 4-metric dock (Sovereign Bedrock, Alpha CAGR, Cashflow Yield, Verified Modules).
4. **`componentry.dev` & `motion.dev` Physics Sliders:**
   - Real-time SIP compounding range sliders with sub-50ms DOM recalculation.
5. **`toggle.supply` Tactile Interaction Switches:**
   - Solid high-contrast toggle buttons with deep offset shadows (`box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000`).
